newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica files shelf $1.5 bln pref, debt.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica files shelf $1.5 bln pref, debt.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp said Tuesday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for up to $1.5 billion in preferred and debt securities.
The preferred securities, known as cumulative Quarterly Income Preferred Securities (QUIPS), represent interests in BankAmerican Capital I, a business trust owned by BankAmerica.

Net proceeds from the sale of the QUIPS will be invested by the trust in junior subordinated debentures of BankAmerica. The San Francisco-based bankholding company will use funds for general corporate purposes.
The preferred securities offering will be made through Goldman, Sachs & Co.
